callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.from_proj_dir
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a path to a valid project directory.
callees.post_condition: Returns a CodeGraphExtractor instance initialized from the project directory, or None if initialization fails.

callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.get_function_spans
callees.signature: get_function_spans(language: str, filepath: str) -> list[tuple[str, int, int]]
callees.pre_condition: The CodeGraphExtractor instance is initialized. language is a recognized language key. filepath is a path to a source file in the given language.
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of (function_name, start_line, end_line) tuples for all functions found in the file, where line indices are 0-indexed and inclusive. Returns an empty list if no functions are found.
